title: Ribbon Tool Tree
description: Replace the fixed two-level toolbar (category -> tools) with an arbitrary-depth recursive tree of buttons, toggles, and collections, rendered as a drill-down ribbon in the footer.
summary: Ribbon document fix: sibling leaf-only collections (e.g. selection → methods/mode/targets) now flatten into separate toolbar zones with gap-single between each segment, instead of cramming collection pickers and tool groups into one zone. Picker path stops at levels that need a collection choice (resolveDefaultToolPath returns [selection] not [selection, methods]). Root collection pickers still single-select and replace downstream zones.
